translations.web: Let not many of you be teachers, my brothers, knowing that we will receive heavier judgment.
translations.bsb: Not many of you should become teachers, my brothers, because you know that we who teach will be judged more strictly.
translations.kjv: My brethren, be not many masters, knowing that we shall receive the greater condemnation.
translations.asv: Be not many of you teachers, my brethren, knowing that we shall receive heavier judgment.
